## Current position

**Postdoctoral Research Fellow**, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Spain (2026–present).

## Previous academic positions

- **Juan de la Cierva Postdoctoral Research Fellow**, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Spain (2024–2026).
- **Postdoctoral Research Fellow**, Tel Aviv University, based at CERN (2021–2024).
- **PhD in Particle Physics**, LPNHE, France (2017–2021). Thesis: *Studies of photon isolation in a large-pileup environment and search for axion-like particles decaying into two photons with the ATLAS detector at the LHC*.
- **Master's Degree in Particle Physics (NPAC)**, Sorbonne Université (2016–2017).
- **BSc in Physics**, Universidad Complutense de Madrid (2012–2016).

## Research profile

Experimental particle physics with the ATLAS experiment, including Higgs boson and beyond-the-Standard-Model searches, photon and lepton reconstruction and isolation, trigger techniques, and background estimation.

## Selected experience

- ATLAS Higgs and Light Resonance Searches Convener (2024–2026).
- ATLAS Isolation and Fakes Forum Convener (2022–2024).
- ATLAS Electron and Photon Upgrade Coordination Contact (2021–2024).
- More than 180 hours of teaching and supervision of more than 10 students since 2018.

For publications, talks, teaching and additional responsibilities, see the corresponding sections of this website.
